CADMIUM.gloss: a soft bluish-white ductile malleable toxic bivalent metallic element
CADMIUM.definition: A soft bluish-white ductile malleable toxic bivalent metallic element; occurs in association with zinc ores.

ACID.gloss: any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning…
ACID.definition: Any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt.

IMAM.gloss: the man who leads prayers in a mosque
IMAM.definition: (Islam) the man who leads prayers in a mosque; for Shiites an imam is a recognized authority on Islamic theology and law and a spiritual guide.

MICA.gloss: any of various minerals consisting of hydrous silicates of aluminum or potassium etc.…
MICA.definition: Any of various minerals consisting of hydrous silicates of aluminum or potassium etc. that crystallize in forms that allow perfect cleavage into very thin leaves; used as dielectrics because of their resistance to electricity.

AID.gloss: a person or thing that is a resource that helps make something easier or possible to do
AID.definition: A person or thing that is a resource that helps make something easier or possible to do.

MAD.example: Stayed huffy a good while"- Mark Twain.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

MAC.gloss: a waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric
MAC.definition: A waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric.

MUM.gloss: failing to speak or communicate etc when expected to
MUM.definition: Failing to speak or communicate etc when expected to.

DAM.gloss: a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea
DAM.definition: A barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea.

MUD.definition: Water soaked soil; soft wet earth.

CAM.gloss: a rotating disk shaped to convert circular into linear motion
CAM.definition: A rotating disk shaped to convert circular into linear motion.

CUM.gloss: the thick white fluid containing spermatozoa that is ejaculated by the male genital tract
CUM.definition: The thick white fluid containing spermatozoa that is ejaculated by the male genital tract.
